title: Waza: Deterministic Trajectory, Tool Constraint & Skill Invocation Graders
summary: Evaluates agent execution transcripts deterministically across three complementary graders: `action_sequence` (`exact_match`, `in_order_match`, `any_order_match` with Precision/Recall/F1), `tool_constraint` (case-insensitive compiled regexes for `tool`, `command_pattern`, `skill_pattern`, `path_pattern`), and `skill_invocation` (`required_skills`, `forbidden_skills`, `allow_extra`).

references.description: Action sequence matching modes and Precision/Recall/F1 scoring
Tool, command, skill, and path regex constraint compilation
Required/forbidden skill invocation grader with allow_extra control
